# Document review

## Section 0: review decisions

A reviewer reads the document, leaves a precise **annotation**, and sends the next batch to an agent. The agent responds to each item and the reviewer accepts the result. [Reference](https://example.com/reference/0) and `version_0` preserve stable context.

- Read the current text before editing.
- Preserve unrelated changes and the original file format.
- Return an explicit result for every requested item.

> Review data belongs to the project and remains available through Git.

| Object | Owner | State |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Document 0 | Reviewer | Open |
| Batch 0 | Agent | Complete |

```yaml
review:
  item: 0
  enabled: true
```

Review note 0: explain the change before accepting it.
